content.comment_body: Does anyone know how to make the [product_name] operator display show leading zeros? For example, displaying 0015 instead of 15. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked if the [product_name] operator display can show numbers with leading zeros, such as 0015 instead of 15. Community feedback suggests this feature is not supported, indicating a limitation in the formatting options of the device's display. This may affect users who need consistent numerical formatting on screen.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated the [product_name] operator display would allow for customizable number formatting, including the option to show leading zeros.
